findings.m15_bpe_conflict: default BPE can merge multi-digit numbers, so one token may receive majority digit/place features from multiple characters.
findings.partial_generation: partial trace rows receive features only for digits that match known row patterns; malformed multi-digit chunks can be interpreted as decimal spans by generic position features.
findings.seq128_to_seq256_confound: M-15 staged continuation skipped position_embedding.weight when sequence length changed from 128 to 256.
findings.service_digits_in_task_names: decimal spans inside labels like ADD2_COMPOSED are numeric spans under digit_safe unless the data format avoids digits in command names.
